shared_elements: hair or headdress rendered as a framing mass around the face
schematic facial features (brow ridge, nose, mouth) in low relief
incised linear detailing on the surface of the form
justification: Both depict a frontal, blocky anthropomorphic figure whose face is framed by a heavy hair/headdress mass carved in low relief with incised linear detail, and both keep the body or head as a broad columnar mass with minimal modelling. However, A shows only a head with a distinctive scalloped, overlapping curl arrangement and a bared grid of teeth, whereas B shows a whole standing figure with straight striated side-locks, a necklace bearing a prominent disc pendant, and a belted torso — attributes absent from A.
